channel.title: CineFood Italia — Blog
channel.description: The guide to Italian restaurants, bars and cafés seen in films and TV series.

item.title: The Gentlemen 2: Where It Was Filmed in Italy
item.description: The Gentlemen season 2 was not filmed on Lake Como: the Italian set is Lake Maggiore, in Verbania, Pallanza, Intra and Stresa. Real locations and where to eat.

item.title: Una finestra vista lago: Where It Was Filmed
item.description: Bellamo does not exist: the Rai series was filmed on Lake Orta, between Orta San Giulio and Miasino, plus the Cernobbio jetty. Real locations and where to eat.

item.title: Tucci in Calabria: Cipolla Rossa in Tropea
item.description: Where Stanley Tucci ate in Calabria in Searching for Italy: Osteria della Cipolla Rossa near Tropea, with its red onion spaghetti.

item.title: Tucci in Liguria: Cracco in Portofino, Genoa
item.description: Where Stanley Tucci ate in Liguria in Searching for Italy: Cracco Portofino on the quay and Il Genovese in Genoa, with pansotti and mortar-made pesto.

item.title: Tucci in Puglia: Antichi Sapori and Matera
item.description: Where Stanley Tucci ate in Puglia in Searching for Italy: Antichi Sapori in Montegrosso, Bere Vecchie in Cisternino and Vitantonio Lombardo in Matera.

item.title: Tucci in Sardinia: Alghero, Cagliari, Pula
item.description: Where Stanley Tucci ate in Sardinia in Searching for Italy: Mabrouk in Alghero, Luigi Pomata in Cagliari and Fradis Minoris on the Nora lagoon.

item.title: Tucci in Umbria: Giorgione in Montefalco
item.description: Where Stanley Tucci ate in Umbria in Searching for Italy: Giorgione's restaurant Alla Via di Mezzo in Montefalco, in a 14th-century oil mill.

item.title: Tucci in Le Marche: Uliassi in Senigallia
item.description: Where Stanley Tucci ate in Le Marche in Tucci in Italy: Uliassi in Senigallia, the three-Michelin-star restaurant born in 1990 as a beach kiosk.

item.title: Eat Pray Love in Rome: Locations & Restaurants
item.description: Where Eat Pray Love was filmed in Rome: Piazza Navona, Villa Borghese and Trastevere, plus the trattorias of the film and the Naples pizzeria. Real addresses.

item.title: I laureati Filming Location: Coco Lezzone, Florence
item.description: Where was I laureati by Pieraccioni filmed? In Florence, with a scene at Trattoria Coco Lezzone on Via del Parioncino: what to eat and how to get there.

item.title: Io sono Li Filming Location: Chioggia's Osteria
item.description: Where was Andrea Segre's Io sono Li filmed? In Chioggia: the film's osteria, Osteria Paradiso on Canal Lombardo, still exists and shows the film's posters.

item.title: La corrispondenza Location: Restaurant San Giulio
item.description: Where was Tornatore's La corrispondenza filmed? On Lake Orta, with Ristorante San Giulio dressed in Portuguese style for a scene, according to Italy for Movies.

item.title: La moglie del prete: Restaurant Al Zocco
item.description: Where was Dino Risi's La moglie del prete (The Priest's Wife) filmed? At Al Zocco restaurant near Vicenza, where Loren and Mastroianni lunch.

item.title: Somebody Feed Phil in Modena: Osteria Francescana
item.description: Where Phil Rosenthal ate in Modena in Somebody Feed Phil: Osteria Francescana, Bar Tiffany for gnocco fritto, La Consorteria 1966 and Mercato Albinelli.

item.title: Somebody Feed Phil in Venice: Where Phil Ate
item.description: Where Phil Rosenthal ate in Venice on the Netflix show: from Al Covo, maybe the city's best restaurant, to the famous pork chop at Vini da Arturo.

item.title: Stanley Tucci in Emilia-Romagna: Rimini, Bologna
item.description: Where Stanley Tucci ate in Emilia-Romagna in Searching for Italy: Osteria io e Simone in Rimini, Salumeria Simoni in Bologna, Casa Artusi. What we know.

item.title: Stanley Tucci in Florence: Cinghiale Bianco
item.description: Where Stanley Tucci ate in Florence in Searching for Italy: ribollita, pappa al pomodoro and panzanella at Osteria del Cinghiale Bianco, on Borgo San Jacopo.

item.title: Stanley Tucci in Milan: Ratanà, Osteria del Treno
item.description: Where Stanley Tucci ate in Milan in Searching for Italy: cotoletta and risotto at Ratanà, then Osteria del Treno. Addresses, dishes and what we know.

item.title: Stanley Tucci in Piedmont: Del Cambio, Vercelli
item.description: Where Stanley Tucci ate in Piedmont in Searching for Italy: Del Cambio restaurant in Turin and the risotto restaurant Christian e Manuel in Vercelli.

item.title: Stanley Tucci in Sicily: Where He Ate
item.description: Where Stanley Tucci ate in Sicily in Searching for Italy: I Pupi in Bagheria, Mè Cumpari Turiddu in Catania, plus Palermo and Lampedusa. Addresses and dishes.

item.title: Stanley Tucci in Venice: Where He Ate
item.description: Where Stanley Tucci ate in Venice in Searching for Italy: the bacaro All'Arco, Villa 600 on Torcello, Venissa on Mazzorbo and Orient Experience.

item.title: Bourdain in Rome: Trastevere's Secret Trattoria
item.description: Anthony Bourdain's favorite cacio e pepe in Rome is at Ristorante Roma Sparita, in Trastevere: the real story behind the No Reservations episode.

item.title: Harry's Bar: the Other Face of Rome's Dolce Vita
item.description: Open since 1918 on Via Veneto, Harry's Bar is still in business today: the story of the venue that really lived the phenomenon Fellini portrayed.

item.title: Where Is Màkari Filmed? Tonnara di Scopello
item.description: Marilù's restaurant in Màkari is a set built inside the Tonnara di Scopello: the real story behind the Rai series with Claudio Gioè, in Sicily.

item.title: Naples on Screen: Film Locations & Restaurants
item.description: From Eat Pray Love to My Brilliant Friend, from Commissioner Ricciardi to Gambrinus: a guide to Naples venues that really appeared in films and TV shows.

item.title: Blocco 181: Milan Was Filmed in Turin
item.description: The Sky series about Milan was shot almost entirely in Turin: Ristorante Del Cambio is among the 100+ locations used for season 2.

item.title: Commissioner Ricciardi Locations: Gambrinus
item.description: Commissioner Ricciardi's table really exists: at Naples' Gran Caffè Gambrinus, reserved after the Rai series became a hit.

item.title: Diabolik Ginko Attacks: Filming Locations, Trieste
item.description: How Trieste became Clerville in Diabolik - Ginko Attacks!: the car chase in Piazza della Borsa and the scene at Caffè San Marco.

item.title: La porta rossa (The Red Door): Trieste Locations
item.description: The historic Trieste café that appears in The Red Door: Antico Caffè San Marco, a recurring set of the Rai noir with Lino Guanciale.

item.title: Honeymoons: Verdone's Real Wedding Reception
item.description: Where Ivano and Jessica celebrate their wedding in Carlo Verdone's Honeymoons: Ristorante Paradiso Terrestre, still open in Rome.

item.title: Don Matteo Filming Locations in Gubbio: Caffè Ducale
item.description: Where Don Matteo and Sergeant Cecchini played chess: Caffè Ducale in Gubbio, a real set for many seasons of the Rai series.

item.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2 Filming Locations: Milan
item.description: Where The Devil Wears Prada 2 was filmed in Milan: Palazzo Parigi Hotel and Caffè Parigi, the cast's base during the 2025 shoot.

item.title: From Scratch Filming Locations in Florence
item.description: Where Lino works in From Scratch: Buca dell'Orafo, a historic Florentine trattoria near Ponte Vecchio, the Netflix series' real location.

item.title: Amalfi Coast Filming Locations: Ripley, Equalizer
item.description: The real Amalfi Coast filming locations: Atrani in Netflix's Ripley and in The Equalizer 3, Positano in Hotel Costiera.

item.title: The Godfather in Forza d'Agrò and Savoca: Locations
item.description: Where The Godfather was filmed in Sicily: Savoca, Forza d'Agrò and Al Pacino's Bar Vitelli. A complete guide to the film's real locations.

item.title: Real Movie Restaurants in Italy: The Full List
item.description: From Al Pacino to Julia Roberts, Denzel Washington to Lady Gaga: every real restaurant, bar and café seen in a movie, verified one by one.

item.title: TV Shows Filmed in Italy: The Real Locations

item.title: Running to You: dinner at Del Cambio
item.description: Favino and Miriam Leone dine at Turin's Del Cambio in Corro da te: the historic restaurant on Piazza Carignano, open since 1757.

item.title: Equalizer 3 Filming Location: Atrani's Café
item.description: Where was The Equalizer 3 filmed? Atrani, the fictional 'Altamonte', and Ristorante Savò, the real café of Denzel Washington's film.

item.title: Hannibal Filming Locations in Florence: Rivoire
item.description: The Florence locations of Ridley Scott's Hannibal, from Caffè Rivoire on Piazza della Signoria to Palazzo Vecchio and Santa Croce.

item.title: Il Re (The King) in Trieste: Filming Locations
item.description: The Sky series with Luca Zingaretti filmed in Trieste across Piazza Oberdan, the Porto Vecchio and inside the Antico Caffè San Marco.

item.title: Rocco Schiavone Filming Locations in Aosta
item.description: The Caffè Nazionale on Piazza Chanoux was reopened just to film Rocco Schiavone. Today it's genuinely open again, with chef Paolo Griffa.

item.title: Where Was The American Filmed? Sulmona, Abruzzo
item.description: Where was The American with George Clooney filmed? Sulmona's Piazza Garibaldi, Castel del Monte, Calascio and more. Caffè Tucci took down its gazebo.

item.title: Where Was My Brilliant Friend Filmed? Real Places
item.description: My Brilliant Friend filming locations: Lila and Elena's neighborhood is a set in Marcianise, while café ScottoJonno in Naples, reopened in 2023, is real.

item.title: The Hand of God Filming Locations in Naples
item.description: Paolo Sorrentino's Netflix film is shot between real Naples streets and Villa Giusso, an agriturismo on the Sorrentine Peninsula.

item.title: Emily in Paris Rome Locations: Real Restaurants
item.description: Emily in Paris season 5: the real Rome and Venice restaurants from the Netflix show, from Zuma to Hotel Eden. Where to eat.

item.title: Hotel Costiera Filming Location: Villa Treville
item.description: Hotel Costiera, the Prime Video series with Jesse Williams, is filmed at Villa Treville, Positano: the real hotel and Maestro's restaurant.

item.title: Master of None Modena Locations: Where Dev Ate
item.description: Master of None really visits Modena: Dev discovers Osteria Francescana, one of the world's best restaurants, and Emilia's food capital.

item.title: Where Was Succession Filmed in Tuscany? La Foce
